llm_response.reason: The site was only registered in June 2025 via a registrar in China, but claims to be a Dutch online fashion store. It lacks visible company details or business credentials, leans heavily on psychological claims of safety and free delivery, and uses branding which may not be officially authorized. This, coupled with a very recent domain and lack of transparency, matches several scam website characteristics including ambiguous company information, urgency/safety tactics, and possible misuse of a legitimate brand.
